source: NASA AERONET Version 3, Level 2.0 (cloud-screened, quality-assured) daily averages
method: AOD at 550 nm from AOD at 440 nm and the 440-870 nm Angstrom exponent; a month needs 5+ measured days, a year needs 9+ valid months. The two sites are separate series, never joined.
caveat: Point stations against a 3° × 4° region average, and MERRA-2 assimilates AERONET and MODIS data, so this checks consistency rather than being fully independent.
